node.title: PMA sigma-one scale-two odd-lift boundary owner
node.statement: If a nonzero source word has U(x)=(x-a)V(x^2), the split point a is unique. Degree-<k odd lifts with exact agreement k+1 or k+3 inject into supports {a} union pi^{-1}(A), so their complete count is binom(n/2,k/2+1)<3Q_2(k+2). Applied after the exact-periodic and growing near-coset owners, all three consume fewer than 11 of the 719 first-scale units and have no chart multiplier.
